newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wah Shing units raise stakes in HK firms.
newsitem.headline: Wah Shing units raise stakes in HK firms.

text.p: Toy manufacturer Wah Shing International Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday a unit Man Wah Trading Ltd bought 8.62 million shares in Pricerite Group Ltd for HK$9.28 million.
It said in a statement that the purchase raised Man Wah's stake to 25.68 percent of the issued capital of Pricerite.
Man Wah had previously held 42.73 million shares in Pricerite.
It said the additional shares were acquired through the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong at prices ranging between HK$0.98 to HK$1.12 per share.
The purchase will be funded by internal resources, it said.

Separately, Wah Ngai Investments Ltd, another Wah Shing subsidiary bought an additional 12.25 million shares for HK$7.34 million in Wo Kee Hong (Holdings) Ltd. It now holds 2.3 percent of Wo Kee Hong's capital.
The shares were bought through the subscription of the rights issue at HK$0.50 per share and through the exchange, at prices ranging from HK$0.55 to HK$0.77 for each Wo Kee Hong share.
Wah Shing said the purchases were for the purpose of a long term investment in the consumer products sector and to enable the company to broaden its earnings base.
